## Description


#### What type of PR is this?
/kind bug
/kind flake

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Switches to `LongTimeout` due to slow Prometheus target discovery.

The slow propagation of ServiceMonitor/config reload events could be the reason for the flake, so having a bit extra time seems reasonable.
#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
Fixes #12091

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

## Walkthrough

The pull request increases the timeout for Prometheus target discovery in the TLS-enabled metrics test from `util.MediumTimeout` (45 seconds) to `util.LongTimeout` to accommodate slower metric target discovery and reduce test flakiness.

## Changes

**Prometheus Metrics Target Discovery Timeout**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Prometheus target discovery timeout adjustment** <br> `test/e2e/certmanager/metrics_test.go`|The `gomega.Eventually` timeout in the Prometheus scraping verification check is increased from `util.MediumTimeout` to `util.LongTimeout` to allow additional time for discovery of the Kueue metrics target over TLS.|

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes
